overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the complaint of collusion outside a posted meeting rested on speculation, and members denied any such communication.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Chair and two members colluded outside a posted meeting to remove the executive director, without specific supporting facts.
allegations.key_passage: As there is no evidence that members of the Board deliberated outside of a meeting, we find no violation.
